name: Ben-Varrey
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ben-Varrey is the title of a Manx-water figure. It is a pointer entry in the online encyclopedia. It directs the reader to the entry on the Mermaid, where the spirits of the sea are treated in full. Ben-Varrey therefore names the same folk being that is described under the broader headword Mermaid. Treat this entry as a cross-reference to that main article.

okr.objective: Ben-Varrey points the reader to the Mermaid entry for the fuller account of the sun.
